subject: Ciências
description_pt: Classificar as radiações eletromagnéticas por suas frequências, fontes e aplicações, discutindo e avaliando as implicações de seu uso em controle remoto, telefone celular, raio X, forno de micro-ondas, fotocélulas etc.

components.description_pt: Classificar tipos de radiação eletromagnética por frequência e nível de energia
components.description_en: Classify types of electromagnetic radiation by frequency and energy level
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how frequency of electromagnetic radiation determines the type and magnitude of its effect on matter

components.description_pt: Identificar fontes naturais e tecnológicas de diferentes tipos de radiação eletromagnética
components.description_en: Identify natural and technological sources of different types of electromagnetic radiation
components.cc_component_description: Identify the sun's electromagnetic radiation as the primary energy source driving Earth's climate system

components.description_pt: Associar tipos específicos de radiação eletromagnética com suas aplicações práticas em tecnologia
components.description_en: Associate specific types of electromagnetic radiation with their practical applications in technology
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how the properties of electromagnetic waves are exploited in a named device or system

components.description_pt: Avaliar as implicações à saúde e ao ambiente do uso de radiação eletromagnética em tecnologias cotidianas
components.description_en: Evaluate the health and environmental implications of using electromagnetic radiation in everyday technologies
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

cc_matches.description: The foundation for Earth’s global climate systems is the electromagnetic radiation from the sun, as well as its reflection, absorption, storage, and redistribution among the atmosphere, ocean, and land systems, and this energy’s re-radiation into space.
Communicate technical information about how some technological devices use the principles of wave behavior and wave interactions with matter to transmit and capture information and energy.

Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
Evaluate the validity and reliability of claims in published materials of the effects that different frequencies of electromagnetic radiation have when absorbed by matter.
